messages.text: Build 847 failed again. Same test—integration timeout. Flaky or real? I need to know before I retry.
Send me the job log and the test name. I'll check timing and whether it's resource contention or a real regression.
Here. Test: checkout_flow_e2e. Fails around 80% of the time on the same step.
Pattern matches. The step before it is the payment mock—sometimes it returns in 200ms, sometimes 8 seconds. Not the test; the mock is unstable.
So we need to fix the mock or add a proper timeout. I can add a retry with backoff for that step in the pipeline.
Better: make the mock deterministic. I see a race in the log—two handlers competing. Fix the mock and the flake goes away. Retries just hide it.
I'd rather not mask it. Can you point me to the exact line or service so I can file a ticket?
Payment mock service, handler for POST /simulate. Two threads updating the same state. I'll add it to the incident report with stack traces.
Perfect. I'll hold off on retries and link your report in the ticket. Thanks for finding the needle.
That's what I do. Next time you see a flake, ping me early. We can turn it into a preventive check.
